content.title: New Edition | T-Mobile Center
content.text: The New Edition Way Tour brings together three of music’s most enduring and influential acts: New Edition, Boyz II Men, and Toni Braxton. This landmark event celebrates music, legacy and connection, giving fans a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to experience these legendary artists performing together on a dynamic 360° stage in an up-close and immersive concert experience. The tour’s name honors New Edition’s historic recognition in their hometown of Boston, where a street was renamed New Edition Way to celebrate their profound cultural and musical impact. As pioneers who transformed R&B and inspired generations of artists, New Edition’s legacy includes the rise of solo superstars like Bobby Brown, Ralph Tresvant, Bell Biv DeVoe and Johnny Gill, collectively achieving multiple #1 singles, Grammy®, American Music, and Soul Train Awards, and selling over 40 million albums worldwide. For the first time, New Edition shares the stage with Boyz II Men, the Grammy-winning vocal group discovered by Michael Bivins, known for timeless hits like End of the Road, I’ll Make Love to You, and One Sweet Day. Adding to the lineup, seven-time Grammy Award-winning icon Toni Braxton delivers her sultry hits, including Un-Break My Heart and Breathe Again, contributing to over 70 million records sold worldwide. Together, these artists have sold over 100 million albums, earned dozens of major music awards, and continue to shape the sound and culture of pop and R&B for generations to come.
